ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle BAC=90^\circ$, $D$ is the midpoint of $BC$. If $AB=8$ and $AD=5$, what is the value of $\sin B$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle BAC=90^\circ$, and D is the midpoint of $BC$,\\
it follows that $AD$ is the median to the hypotenuse $BC$ of the right-angled triangle $ABC$,\\
hence, $BC=2AD=2\times 5=10$,\\
given $AB=8$,\\
then, $AC=\sqrt{BC^{2}-AB^{2}}=\sqrt{10^{2}-8^{2}}=6$,\\
thus, $\sin B=\frac{AC}{BC}=\frac{6}{10}=\boxed{\frac{3}{5}}$.
